question: Most of the cave paintings found in Mangar forest area in Haryana are in which colour?
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Ochre.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The answer is **4) ochre.**
 
• As per the given passage, *"Most of the cave paintings found were in **ochre colour,** but some were in white."*
 
• It is mentioned that stones of these colors used to be available locally and inhabitants crushed the stones for preparing the color for paintings.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **4) ochre.**
